summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K attaching a September 28, 2026, press release announcing that minority holders of PCI Geomatics Group Inc. (CATALYST) approved Intermap's acquisition of all PCI shares it does not already own via a Canada Business Corporations Act arrangement. At the September 25 special meeting, the arrangement resolution drew 99.99% of votes cast, with Series B preferred and special shares at 100%. An Ontario Superior Court final order hearing was set for September 28, 2026, with closing expected mid-October 2026. No price per share, premium, or break fee was disclosed.
